2026.name: Lohri
2026.significance: The Punjab bonfire night before Makar Sankranti. Sesame, jaggery and popcorn go into the fire and the winter harvest is thanked.

2026.name: Makar Sankranti
2026.significance: The Sun turns north into Capricorn. The first sankranti of the calendar year, marked with a til-gud exchange and a dip in the river at dawn.
2026.regionalVariants: Pongal (Tamil Nadu), Magh Bihu (Assam), Uttarayan (Gujarat), Khichdi (UP and Bihar)

2026.name: Vasant Panchami (Saraswati Puja)
2026.significance: Saraswati is worshipped at the onset of spring. Books and instruments are placed before her, and a child is often given its first letters today.

2026.name: Maha Shivaratri
2026.significance: The great night of Shiva. Devotees keep the vigil through the four watches, offering bilva leaves and water on the lingam until dawn.

2026.name: Holika Dahan
2026.significance: The bonfire on the Phalguna full moon that burns the old year. Prahlada walked out of the fire and Holika did not; the pyre is lit after sunset.

2026.name: Holi (Dhulandi)
2026.significance: The day of colour, the morning after Holika Dahan. Elders are touched at the feet before colour is thrown on friends.

2026.name: Ugadi / Gudi Padwa
2026.significance: The lunar new year in the Deccan and the west. A gudi is raised at the doorway in Maharashtra; the bevu-bella of neem and jaggery is eaten in the south.

2026.name: Ram Navami
2026.significance: Rama was born at noon on the Chaitra ninth. The Ramayana is read and the cradle is rocked at midday.

2026.name: Mahavir Jayanti
2026.significance: The birth of Mahavira, the last Tirthankara. Jain temples hold the abhishekam of the idol and the day turns on non-violence and restraint.

2026.name: Hanuman Jayanti
2026.significance: Hanuman was born on the Chaitra full moon. The Sundarakanda and the Hanuman Chalisa are read; sindoor and a garland go on the idol.

2026.name: Baisakhi (Vaisakhi)
2026.significance: The solar new year at Mesha sankranti and the Punjab harvest. The Khalsa was founded on this day, so the gurudwara stays open from dawn.
2026.regionalVariants: Puthandu (Tamil Nadu), Pana Sankranti (Odisha), Pohela Boishakh (Bengal, Apr 15)

2026.name: Vishu
2026.significance: Kerala's new year at the solar turn. The Vishukkani is arranged the night before so gold, grain and the image of Krishna are the first sight on waking.

2026.name: Akshaya Tritiya
2026.significance: What begins today does not diminish. One of the four abhijit-style days when every hour is auspicious; gold and grain bought now are said to multiply.

2026.name: Buddha Purnima
2026.significance: The Vaishakha full moon on which the Buddha was born, reached enlightenment and passed away. Bodhi trees are watered and lamps are lit at the vihara.

2026.name: Ganga Dussehra
2026.significance: The day Ganga came down to earth. A dip in any river at first light carries the intent of a bath at Haridwar.

2026.name: Nirjala Ekadashi
2026.significance: The one Ekadashi kept without a drop of water from sunrise to sunrise. Bhima kept only this one; a pot of water given away today carries the year's vrat.

2026.name: Rath Yatra (Puri)
2026.significance: Jagannath leaves the Puri temple on the great chariot with Balabhadra and Subhadra. Odisha empties into the streets to pull the ropes.

2026.name: Guru Purnima
2026.significance: Vyasa's day, when the teacher is honoured. Bow to the one whose words still shape your decisions; if the teacher is gone, light a lamp before their photograph.

2026.name: Naga Panchami
2026.significance: The serpent gods are offered milk on the Shravana fifth. A day of protection from snakebite and of the old bond between the household and the naga.

2026.name: Onam (Thiruvonam)
2026.significance: Kerala's harvest festival, the day King Mahabali returns to his people. The pookalam is laid and the sadya is served on a banana leaf.

2026.name: Raksha Bandhan
2026.significance: The sister ties a thread on the brother's wrist and the brother promises protection for the year. Old bond, simple gesture, no substitute.

2026.name: Krishna Janmashtami
2026.significance: Krishna was born at midnight on the eighth of Bhadrapada's dark fortnight. The fast is broken after the moon rises and the midnight abhishekam is done.

2026.name: Hartalika Teej
2026.significance: Parvati's vrat to win Shiva, kept by married women without food or water. A sand lingam is made and the night is spent in worship.

2026.name: Ganesh Chaturthi
2026.significance: Ganesha arrives in the home. The murti is installed with modak and durva grass, and stays until the visarjan.

2026.name: Vishwakarma Puja
2026.significance: The divine architect is worshipped at Kanya sankranti. Workshops and craftsmen clean and garland their tools, and no work is done on them until the puja is over.

2026.name: Anant Chaturdashi
2026.significance: The Vishnu vrat that also closes the ten-day Ganesha festival with the visarjan. A fourteen-knot thread is tied on the right wrist and endurance is asked of Ananta.

2026.name: Sharad Navaratri (Day 1)
2026.significance: The nine nights of Durga begin. The ghat is installed and the akhand jyoti is lit; the vrat runs to Vijayadashami.

2026.name: Dussehra (Vijayadashami)
2026.significance: Rama killed Ravana and Durga killed Mahishasura on the same day. Work begun on Vijayadashami is said to carry the victory of both.

2026.name: Karva Chauth
2026.significance: Married women fast without water from sunrise until they see the moon at night, then look at the husband through a sieve.

2026.name: Dhanteras
2026.significance: Dhanvantari rose from the ocean with the pot of amrita. A small metal vessel and a few coins are bought; what enters the home now is said to stay.

2026.name: Naraka Chaturdashi (Choti Diwali)
2026.significance: Krishna killed Narakasura before dawn. An oil bath is taken at sunrise and a single diya is lit at the doorway before nightfall.

2026.name: Diwali (Deepavali)
2026.significance: The festival of lights and the Lakshmi puja. Lakshmi visits homes that are clean, lit and welcoming; the puja is done in the pradosh window after sunset.

2026.name: Govardhan Puja (Annakut)
2026.significance: Krishna lifted the Govardhan hill to shelter Vrindavan. The annakut is made, a small mountain of cooked food offered and then shared with the whole house.

2026.name: Bhai Dooj
2026.significance: Yamuna fed her brother Yama. The sister applies tilak on the brother's forehead and the meal she serves is remembered through the year.

2026.name: Chhath Puja
2026.significance: The four-day Surya vrat of the Bhojpuri belt, peaking with the sunset and sunrise arghya to the Sun standing in the river. One of the hardest vrats kept.

2026.name: Tulsi Vivah
2026.significance: The ceremonial marriage of the tulsi plant to Vishnu that opens the wedding season. The courtyard tulsi is dressed as a bride at dusk.

2026.name: Kartik Purnima
2026.significance: The full moon that closes the Kartik vrat month. Varanasi lights the ghats for Dev Deepawali; it is also Guru Nanak Jayanti.

2026.name: Gita Jayanti
2026.significance: The day Krishna spoke the Bhagavad Gita to Arjuna on the field of Kurukshetra. A chapter is read and the text is honoured on the home altar.

2026.name: Dattatreya Jayanti
2026.significance: The birth of Dattatreya, the union of Brahma, Vishnu and Shiva. The Margashira full-moon evening is given to his worship and the reading of his charitra.

makar-sankranti.basis: Sun's sidereal ingress into Makara; punya kaal moves to the next sunrise when the ingress falls after sunset

maha-shivratri.basis: amanta Magha Krishna Chaturdashi (purnimanta Phalguna) prevailing at nishita

holika-dahan.basis: the civil day carrying Phalguna Purnima; the dahan itself waits for Bhadra to end that evening

holi.basis: amanta Phalguna Krishna Pratipada (purnimanta Chaitra) at sunrise, the day after Holika Dahan

raksha-bandhan.basis: Shravana Purnima at sunrise; the previous afternoon sits inside Bhadra in both 2026 and 2027

onam.basis: Thiruvonam (Shravana) nakshatra at sunrise within the Simha / Chingam solar month

janmashtami.basis: amanta Shravana Krishna Ashtami (purnimanta Bhadrapada) at sunrise

hartalika-teej.basis: Bhadrapada Shukla Tritiya present during pratahkala

dussehra.basis: Ashwin Shukla Dashami prevailing at aparahna

karva-chauth.basis: amanta Ashwin Krishna Chaturthi (purnimanta Kartika) prevailing at moonrise

dhanteras.basis: amanta Ashwin Krishna Trayodashi (purnimanta Kartika) running in the pradosh window, because the puja is an evening rite

naraka-chaturdashi.basis: amanta Ashwin Krishna Chaturdashi (purnimanta Kartika) at sunrise

diwali.basis: amanta Ashwin Amavasya (purnimanta Kartika) present in the pradosh window, because the Lakshmi puja is a pradosh rite

govardhan-puja.basis: Kartika Shukla Pratipada at sunrise (udaya, Drik Panchang convention; founder ruling 2026-10-25); a kshaya pratipada goes to the day it runs

bhai-dooj.basis: Kartika Shukla Dwitiya at sunrise, which is also the aparahna the tilak needs

chhath-puja.basis: Kartika Shukla Shashthi present at sunset, when the sandhya arghya is offered

tulsi-vivah.basis: Kartika Shukla Dwadashi at sunrise, the day after Prabodhini Ekadashi

gita-jayanti.basis: Margashirsha Shukla Ekadashi (Mokshada Ekadashi) at sunrise

datta-jayanti.basis: Margashirsha Purnima present at pradosh; in 2026 that Purnima never touches a sunrise
